baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated forms in 'you will not unless Allah wills' retain a human grammatical subject while placing that willing inside an exception condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human willing is real but neither self-originating nor independently effective. The exception blocks autonomous willing, not the existence of a human act of willing.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally gives willing or choosing a thing; its repetition supplies the two volitional levels that the exception nests rather than conflates.

changed_reading.before: The first clause simply cancels human will in favor of divine will.
changed_reading.after: The clause preserves human willing as a dependent act whose occurrence and efficacy are enclosed by divine willing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The volitional exception closes with 'Knowing, Wise,' so knowledge and wisdom qualify the divine willing just asserted.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine priority is characterized as informed and truth-hitting governance rather than arbitrary force: what can be willed is fully disclosed to knowledge and ordered by wisdom.

activation_trace.role: Willing toward a thing supplies the governed object and action whose divine priority receives the following qualifications.
The literal disclosure of a thing to a knower makes complete apprehension, not opacity, the epistemic condition of divine willing.
Wisdom as knowledge that hits the right locates divine willing within correct discernment and ordering.

changed_reading.before: The verse ranks two wills only by superior power.
changed_reading.after: It ranks them while presenting the enclosing will as fully informed and rightly ordered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception construction limits the reach of 'you will,' while 'Wise' carries a branch of restraining and turning back for repair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human willing is pictured as directional movement that meets a corrective boundary. Divine wisdom does not merely know the movement; it can restrain or redirect it toward right order.

activation_trace.role: The form-distant image of carrying something toward a matter gives volition a directional dynamic for the exception to bound.
Restraining and turning back in order to repair supplies the functional boundary placed around that directional impulse.

changed_reading.before: The exception states a static metaphysical dependency.
changed_reading.after: The exception can also depict active corrective governance over where human willing is able to go.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves from a human not yet present as a mentioned thing through creation from a mixed drop, testing, and the making of hearing and sight. Human willing in 76:30 therefore appears as a developed, created capacity of a tested perceiver, not as a primordial power standing beside divine willing.

activation_trace.role: Being or occurring in time supplies the initial absence from which the later human willing subject emerges.
The knowable or reportable thing marks the ontological and epistemic status the human had not yet attained.
Mention running on the tongue supplies the absent public recognizability from which the surah begins.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the causal transition from non-mentioned thing to acting human.
Water ranging from a drop to a larger body gives the human subject a materially minute origin.
Literal mixing makes the originating material composite rather than self-grounded.
Testing that makes a condition appear gives the created capacities an arena in which willing becomes manifest.
Making something into a state supplies the transition by which perceptual agency is conferred.
Literal auditory perception supplies one created intake through which a tested agent can respond.
Literal sight supplies the paired perceptual capacity of the eventual willing subject.
Willing toward a thing anchors the developmental sequence back in the focus claim about dependent human willing.

structural_cues: 76:1 denies prior being as a mentioned thing, and 76:2 immediately narrates creation, testing, and conferred perception.
The focus human plural subject arrives only after this whole created history.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered emergence from non-mention to creation, testing, hearing, and sight; I infer that volitional capacity belongs to that conferred development. A live alternative is that the opening only describes human status and does not specify how willing is constituted.

changed_reading.before: Human and divine wills are compared as already given powers.
changed_reading.after: The human will being qualified is itself a late, created capacity of a composite and tested perceiver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance first discloses a traversable way with grateful and ungrateful responses; the reminder later says that whoever wills may acquire a way toward the Lord. The focus qualification then preserves willing as responsive path uptake while denying that the traveler supplies the path, orientation, or enabling will.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies an offered orientation rather than forced arrival.
A path extended for travel supplies the spatial mechanism in which a response can become movement.
Recognition of a benefit and praise of its giver supplies one accountable response to guidance.
Covering a benefit supplies the opposed response, preserving a real contrast in path uptake.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the renewed disclosure immediately before the willing traveler acts.
Willing toward a thing explicitly supplies the human volitional response that 76:30 qualifies.
Taking or acquiring supplies an active appropriation of the offered route.
Nurturing, repair, and completion make the Lord the route's formative destination, not merely its endpoint.
The repeated extended path closes the guidance arc and places human willing inside a provided route.
The same willing branch anchors the focus as a qualification of the path-taking act rather than its deletion.

structural_cues: 76:3 introduces guidance, path, and two responses; 76:29 repeats reminder, willing, taking, and path.
76:30 begins with a conjunction and directly qualifies the willing clause in 76:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated guidance-path-response sequence and an immediate will-to-take-path clause; I infer that the exception governs enabled uptake rather than cancelling response. A live alternative is to read the path language only as moral description while treating 76:30 as an unrelated metaphysical correction.

changed_reading.before: Dependence means the human subject contributes no meaningful movement.
changed_reading.after: Dependence means responsive movement occurs on a disclosed, sustained route whose possibility is not authored by the traveler.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah attributes concrete acts to people, names their endurance, returns recompense, and calls the endeavor 'your striving' and thanked. Read after that sequence, 76:30 relocates the source and efficacy of will without making human action morally empty.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies deliberate fulfillment as a humanly predicated act.
Giving food to another supplies a concrete outward action through which willing becomes socially effective.
Will and intention literally appear in the agents' denial of seeking repayment, showing reflexive motive within action.
Holding oneself back from collapse supplies sustained agency rather than a momentary impulse.
Returning a corresponding consequence supplies moral recognition of the performed action.
Work, earning, and purposeful activity supply the explicitly possessed 'your striving' that dependency does not erase.
Recognition of benefit supplies divine acknowledgment of that striving rather than dismissal of it as unreal.
The focus willing branch is thereby read as dependent agency compatible with credited effort.

structural_cues: 76:7-9 repeatedly predicates fulfilling, feeding, and intending of the human speakers.
76:22 addresses them with 'your striving' before 76:30 qualifies human willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies humanly predicated deeds, motive, recompense, and thanked striving; I infer that the later dependency clause cannot reduce those attributions to empty appearances. A live alternative is that reward language is accommodative and does not settle the metaphysics of agency.

changed_reading.before: Divine willing makes human effort merely apparent or causally irrelevant.
changed_reading.after: Divine willing encloses human agency while the surah still treats intention, endurance, action, and striving as genuinely attributable and answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the reminder and will clauses, creation, tightened bodily cohesion, divine willing, replacement, and likeness form one material sequence. Divine willing is shown as implementable reconfiguration of embodied patterns, while human willing is housed within a body whose cohesion and continuity it did not establish.

activation_trace.role: Creative bringing-into-being supplies the body's dependence before any claim about the subject's will.
Tightening a knot or bond supplies the act that secures bodily coherence.
Strength of constitution and cohesive joints literalize the embodied structure within which human willing operates.
Divine willing toward a thing supplies the condition under which bodily continuity can be altered.
Changing a thing's form supplies the concrete implementation of the preceding divine will.
A likeness or counterpart supplies the replaceable pattern against which personal continuity is threatened.
The focus repetition generalizes the immediately demonstrated asymmetry between constituted human willing and implementable divine willing.

structural_cues: 76:28 places creation, bodily fastening, divine willing, and replacement in one sentence.
Only 76:29 intervenes before the focus qualification of human willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily construction and replacement as the immediate example of divine willing; I infer that this material asymmetry informs the next volitional qualification. A live alternative is that 76:28 is only a threat of replacement and does not characterize the mechanics of will in 76:30.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares two disembodied faculties of choice.
changed_reading.after: Human willing is an activity of a constituted body, while divine willing is displayed as able to secure, alter, or replace the embodied pattern itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation is delivered, patience is commanded under the Lord's judgment, rival obedience is refused, and remembrance, prostration, and glorification occupy recurring times. The focus exception therefore functions within a governance and formation sequence: will is trained into allegiance under wise judgment, not discussed only as an isolated inner faculty.

activation_trace.role: Sending something down and delivering it supplies an external divine address that forms the addressee's response.
Reading and recitation supply the articulated guidance through which allegiance is repeatedly heard.
Holding the self against collapse supplies the sustained posture required under judgment.
Judgment and adjudication supply the governing order echoed by 'Wise' in the focus.
Submission and obedience supply the rival directional claim that must be refused.
Delay from the good supplies the first corrupt allegiance against which willing is formed.
Covering a benefit supplies the second rival posture named in the refusal command.
Bringing something back to presence after absence supplies repeated attentional formation.
Lowering and submission supply an embodied practice of directed allegiance.
Declaring transcendence and freedom from defect supplies the verbal practice that reorders attention.
Wisdom as right-hitting knowledge anchors the preceding judgment and formation sequence in the focus predicate.
Willing toward a thing becomes the formed allegiance governed by the sequence rather than a contextless impulse.

structural_cues: 76:23-26 is a continuous chain from revelation to patience, refusal of obedience, remembrance, prostration, and glorification.
The root of 'judgment' in 76:24 recurs as 'Wise' in 76:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an address-practice-governance sequence before the focus; I infer that these acts form and direct willing under divine judgment. A live alternative is that the imperatives regulate conduct while 76:30 separately states the ontology of will.

changed_reading.before: Will is an instantaneous, private choice whose only issue is causal independence.
changed_reading.after: Will is also an allegiance formed over time by received speech, restrained rival obedience, remembrance, and embodied worship under wise governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding diagnosis links love to the hastened present and abandonment to a heavy day placed out of view; then reminder, willing, and path follow. The focus exposes human will as affectively pulled and temporally short-sighted, while divine willing opens the possibility of orientation beyond what currently attracts attention.

activation_trace.role: Love lodged in the heart supplies the affective attachment shaping the subjects' apparent choices.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the near-term horizon favored by that attachment.
Leaving a thing supplies the active neglect paired with love of the immediate.
Covering something and putting it behind the back supplies the mechanism by which the longer horizon loses salience.
A day's severe event supplies the deferred reality that the subjects place behind them.
Weight opposed to lightness gives that deferred day the aversive load from which attention retreats.
A reminder supplies the countermeasure that brings the neglected horizon back into attention.
The branch's literal attraction or delight toward a thing makes willing legible as affectively drawn, not neutrally self-transparent.
The extended path supplies a durable horizon opposed to fixation on the immediate.
The same attraction branch anchors the focus qualification in a diagnosis of desire's limited horizon.

structural_cues: 76:27 diagnoses love of the immediate and abandonment of the heavy day; 76:29-30 then place reminder, willing, path, and divine willing in sequence.
The contrast is temporal as well as moral: brought-forward attraction versus a consequential day put behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies love, haste, abandonment, concealment-behind, weight, reminder, and willing; I infer that these describe the attentional conditions under which human will operates. A live alternative is that 76:27 classifies preferences without explaining the faculty of will itself.

changed_reading.before: Human willing is a neutral faculty that transparently selects among options.
changed_reading.after: Human willing is pulled by near-term love and selective inattention, so its dependence includes the need for a horizon it does not generate by itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah operationalizes divine willing as admitting someone into mercy, then contrasts wrongdoers with prepared painful punishment. The asymmetry turns 76:30 from bare sovereignty into an informed threshold that distinguishes merciful ingress from consequence attached to wrongdoing.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry into an interior supplies the threshold action by which divine willing becomes effective.
Divine willing toward a thing supplies the selection governing admission.
Mercy and tenderness supply the interior domain into which the selected person is admitted.
Putting a thing outside its proper time or place supplies an ethical disorder named on the contrasting side.
Preparing equipment or provision supplies the deliberate readiness of the consequence.
Pain and punishment supply the consequence opposed to entry into mercy.
Literal hurt and suffering intensify the prepared consequence rather than leaving the contrast abstract.
Full disclosure to the knower anchors the differentiation in knowledge rather than ignorance.
Right-hitting wisdom anchors the threshold and consequence in discriminating governance rather than caprice.

structural_cues: 76:31 immediately repeats divine willing from 76:30 and gives it the transitive outcome of admission into mercy.
The mercy clause names whom God wills, while the contrasted punishment clause names wrongdoers and preparation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate repetition, admission into mercy, and a contrasting wrongdoing-consequence clause; I infer that the syntax differentiates gracious ingress from accountable consequence. A live alternative is that both halves primarily assert unrestricted sovereign assignment, with the asymmetry carrying less explanatory weight.

changed_reading.before: Divine willing is an undifferentiated override whose outcomes remain unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Divine willing is immediately rendered as a knowing and wise threshold into mercy, contrasted with a prepared consequence explicitly attached to wrongdoing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The womb image is surprising because it activates a non-dominant bodily branch of mercy across the surah's conception imagery. It remains anchored through the focus willing clause and the immediate 'admits whom He wills into His mercy.' Downstream prose should present this only as a gestational spatial analogy, never as a lexical replacement of mercy with womb or as a claim about literal rebirth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The divine willing in 76:30 is immediately repeated as admission into mercy in 76:31.

activation_trace.role: Willing toward a thing anchors the proposed developmental admission in the focus's divine-human relation.
The literal generative drop supplies the beginning of the surah's first developmental enclosure.
Literal mixture supplies the formative material developed within that first creation sequence.
Entry into an interior supplies the spatial move that permits a second, metaphorical enclosure.
The literal womb branch supplies the contained gestational image for mercy without replacing the surface sense.

changed_reading.before: Divine willing merely grants an external destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine willing can be imagined as admitting a created, developing subject into a protective formative interior of mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bridle is a form-distant concrete branch of 'Wise,' so reading it into the predicate is deliberately odd. It remains anchored in focus حكيم, the exception's limiting syntax, the earlier judgment and obedience command, and the bodily fastening of 76:28. Downstream prose should label it a governing material analogy, not translate حكيم as 'bridler' or infer compulsion from the image alone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus حكيم follows an exception that limits where human willing can run.

activation_trace.role: The literal jaw-fitting that restrains an animal supplies the bridle image for wise limitation.
Driving something toward a matter supplies the directional motion that the bridle image can govern.
Restraining and turning back for repair gives the bridle analogy a corrective rather than merely coercive function.
Obedient submission supplies the contested direction from which the addressee is told to turn.
Tightening a bond supplies a nearby material restraint image that resonates with the bridle.
Cohesive bodily joints keep the analogy attached to constituted capacity rather than an externally shackled ghost.

changed_reading.before: Wise is a general honorific appended after a doctrine of will.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Wise makes divine willing the corrective bridle that gives dependent human motion a governed range.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hydrological mechanism is cross-domain and does not supply the lexical meaning of شاء. It remains anchored in the focus branch of being carried toward a matter and in the surah's linked drops, channels, paths, springs, gushing, and watering. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for enabled direction: real flow within a supplied source and course, not proof that volition is literally water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch 'carrying something toward a matter' allows willing to be pictured as directed movement whose course is conditioned.

activation_trace.role: Carrying something toward a matter supplies the directional focus anchor for the flow analogy.
A watercourse and the opening of its way supply the earliest channel image in the whole-surah sequence.
Water from drop to larger body supplies the material origin of the later willing subject.
An extended traversable path supplies the channel's directional analogue.
A flowing spring supplies a source from which directed movement can proceed.
Wide splitting and outflow supply active release and routing rather than inert containment.
Giving drink until thirst is relieved supplies a divinely delivered flow reaching its recipient.
The closing path returns the channel image directly to the human willing qualified in the next ayah.

changed_reading.before: Dependence is an on-off permission imposed on an otherwise self-contained will.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, human willing is a real directed flow whose source, opened channel, and ability to reach its course depend on divine willing.

strongest_changes: The human will became an emergent capacity of a created, tested perceiver rather than a primordial rival power.
The guidance and path repetitions preserved responsive uptake inside divine enablement.
Concrete deeds and 'your striving' prevented the dependency clause from collapsing accountable effort into unreality.
The immediate sequel rendered divine willing as admission into mercy contrasted with prepared consequence for wrongdoing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made 76:30 function as a hinge joining origin, testing, path response, credited action, disciplined allegiance, embodied replaceability, distorted temporal desire, and final admission. The focus remained multivalent: dependent agency, wise corrective governance, and several contained material analogies coexist without forced resolution.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly preserves attributable action but does not by itself specify a complete causal metaphysics of co-agency.
The affective, embodied, and formative models may describe conditions of willing without defining the exact force of the exception construction.
The womb, bridle, and flow readings are branch-backed analogies whose explanatory value exceeds their lexical certainty.
